items.title: Kaufland Romania Achieves €4bn In Revenue In 2025 Financial Year
items.summary: Kaufland Romania reported a turnover of €4.2 billion in its 2025 financial year, spanning March 2025 to February 2026.

items.title: Investments in stores and assortment lead Wibra to a new record year
items.summary: Last year, Wibra once again saw its revenue rise by more than a quarter. This growth is not solely due to new store openings; existing stores are also performing strongly. The discount retailer still sees plenty of opportunities in the Netherlands, Belgium, and France.

items.title: Gruppo Selex Targets 4.5% Revenue Growth In 2026
items.summary: Gruppo Selex is targeting revenue of €23.3 billion in FY 2026, or 4.5% growth compared to the €22.3 billion reported in 2025.

items.title: Edeka NST Sees Growth In Full-Year Retail Sales Following Investment Programme
items.summary: Edeka NST has reported 2.4% year-on-year increase in retail sales, to €5.52 billion, driven by its investment strategy in FY 2025.

items.title: Uber Eats slows down in Europe amid battle for Delivery Hero
items.summary: Uber Eats is putting its European expansion on hold, although its parent company, Uber, continues to eye a takeover of the German company Delivery Hero. Presumably, the American food delivery service is keeping a low profile for the time being so as not to provoke the European…

items.title: Jorian van Acker heads Mondelez Benelux with clear goal: one billion euros in revenue
items.summary: Mondelez International has appointed Jorian van Acker as Vice President & Managing Director for the Benelux. He will lead the snack manufacturer’s regional organization with a clear goal: to reach 1 billion euros in revenue by 2030.

items.title: Ten years after the merger: “Strong local brands make Ahold Delhaize unique”
items.summary: Nearly ten years ago, the merger between the Dutch company Royal Ahold and the Belgian Delhaize Group was finalized. CEO Frans Muller sees the strength of as many as 17 local brands as a key factor in the company’s success.

items.title: Asda Appoints Helen Connolly As CEO Of Fashion Brand George
items.summary: UK retailer Asda has appointed Helen Connolly as chief executive officer of George, its fashion and homeware brand.

items.title: Denmark’s Dagrofa To Acquire Discount Chain ABC Lavpris
items.summary: Danish grocery group Dagrofa, a NorgesGruppen affiliate, has announced the acquisition of discount supermarket chain ABC Lavpris.

items.title: Carlsberg, Sapporo to team up in SE Asia and UK

items.title: Go-Tan brings Orkla on board for a growth surge in Europe
items.summary: For the first time in more than 70 years, Go-Tan is selling a stake in the family-owned business. Sweden’s Orkla Foods is acquiring a 40% stake in the Dutch manufacturer of Asian sauces and snacks. The Go family will remain the majority shareholder for the time being.

items.title: Prices are falling in Belgian supermarkets, whilst France remains cheaper
items.summary: Last month, prices in Belgian supermarkets fell for the first time in four years, according to the consumer organization Testaankoop. Belgian shoppers can find even lower prices in France, while the Netherlands is generally more expensive.

items.title: Why and how Unilever sells on TikTok Shop
items.summary: Unilever is preparing to sell through TikTok Shop now that the platform is also active in the Benelux. The company does not expect to see immediate returns, but does see room for further growth in social commerce.

items.title: LVMH CEO Bernard Arnault to pay 22.5 million euros in back taxes
items.summary: Bernard Arnault, chairman and CEO of the luxury group LVMH, and his wife must pay nearly 22.5 million euros in back taxes. The Administrative Court of Appeal in Paris overturned an earlier ruling that had largely exempted the couple.

items.summary: In France, 165 Auchan supermarkets will be allowed to switch to competitor Intermarché under a franchise agreement. The competition authority granted approval for this on Monday.
